t: A 75 minute lesson where teams program a robot arm to sort cubes into bins.
steps: Find the Precision Pick-and-Place Challenge on TeachEngineering.
Read the activity and the design process packet.
Gather one assembled SO-ARM101 arm for each group.
Collect nine small colored objects and three bins per group.
Ask IT to install LeRobot from Hugging Face on each laptop.
Test the arm and software before class.
